Grading Rubric: Literature Review
Criteria | Points | Description
Thesis and Focus | 20 | Exemplary: clear focused thesis. Proficient: thesis present.
Use of Sources | 30 | Integrates five or more peer reviewed sources
Organization | 20 | Logical flow and transitions
APA Formatting | 15 | Correct APA 7 citations and references
Mechanics | 15 | Grammar, spelling, punctuation
